verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a developer transcription API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test mode, or non-production credentials. The playground inputs (sample conversation, recording your own speech) are a demo or try-it feature, not an isolated environment separate from production data, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
